//: Example manifest. A manifest builds one finished video from one or more takes
(parts): it records and renders each part, gates each on qa.mjs, joins them, and
gates the joined result. This one records the example trace against the local
Express app in sample-app/, so it runs anywhere.
cd sample-app && npm start                    (in another terminal)
--only <part>   rebuild just that part; the others are reused
--no-record     re-render from frames already recorded (no Chrome)
--no-gate       keep going when qa.mjs fails (failures are still reported)
--join-only     skip the parts, just re-join and re-check
Then run the video-qa agent on the output - and ask before applying its fixes.
Keys starting with // are notes for people; build.mjs ignores them.
name: grammar-tour
//name: Each part records into out/<name>/<part>/, so no take overwrites another's files.
description: the example trace, recorded against the local Express app
//output: Relative to the repo root. Defaults to out/<name>.mp4.
//env: Environment for every stage of every part; values are strings.
ZOOM_DEPTH: how deep the click zooms go (project.mjs, default 3). AUTO_SPEED: fast-forward factor for logged waits
nobody is talking over (loading, AI generation) - 10 squeezes a 7s spinner to 0.7s.
//joins: Only used with two or more parts: the crossfade between parts, and the silence kept before a part's first word (leadS) and after its last (tailS). Joins are trimmed by measurement, not by hand.

parts.name: tour
parts.before: the sample app answers on http://localhost:3000 (cd sample-app && npm start)
parts.//: script is relative to the repo root; it is generated from scenarios/grammar-tour.trace.json. `before` is printed before the take - say what must be true for it to work.

//more parts: Split a video into parts when one take cannot hold it - typically two users, each
recorded from its own signed-in profile, so nobody signs in on camera. Parts record
in the order listed. A part's target, profile, intro and outro come from its script,
so give the FIRST part's script the intro: and the LAST part's the outro: - a card
on a middle part plays mid-video. A second part looks like this:
"before": "profile-member/ signed in as the member; part 1 left the setting OFF" }
